title: Laundry pre-soak spray
subtitle: A liquid spray for stains before the wash
excerpt: A pre-wash spray of washing soda, Castile soap, and water that loosens food, grease, and grass stains before a normal machine wash. Spray on, wait ten minutes, wash as usual. Makes 300 ml.
sourceNotes: Washing soda stain removal: manufacturer guidance (Dri-Pak Ltd), public FAQ (dripack.co.uk). Castile soap as surfactant stain treatment: open-access formulation references.

recipe.yieldDescription: ~300 ml spray (enough for 30 to 50 stain treatments)
recipe.batchNotes: Doubles to 600 ml; store in a second bottle.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Mixes in minutes; keep a labelled bottle by the washing machine.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Keeps six months in a sealed spray bottle. Discard if the liquid turns yellow or develops a sour smell.

glossaryTerms.definition: A molecule with a water-loving end and an oil-loving end. Castile soap acts as a surfactant: it lifts the oily or protein portion of a stain from fabric and suspends it in water so the machine rinse can carry it away.

content.text: This is a spray to apply to stains before a machine wash. The washing soda softens the water around the stain and loosens mineral-set marks; the Castile soap works as a

that lifts grease and food residue from fibres. Works on most everyday stains: tomato sauce, grass, tea, cooking oil, and baby food. Less effective on set blood, ink, or wine; treat those immediately.

items.prepNote: dissolved in hot water before adding to the bottle
hot (not boiling) to dissolve the washing soda
unscented; added after the washing soda has dissolved and cooled

content.text: Dissolve the washing soda in the hot water in a heatproof jug. Stir until clear.
Allow to cool to room temperature. Do not add the Castile soap while the liquid is hot; the heat can cause the soap to separate.
Pour the cooled washing-soda water into the spray bottle. Add the Castile soap. Fit the cap and swirl gently to combine.

Spray directly onto the stain. Work the spray into the fabric with a fingernail or stiff brush. Leave for 10 minutes, then wash in the machine on a normal cycle. For dried-in stains, leave the spray on for 30 minutes before washing.

Safe on cotton, linen, and synthetic fabrics that can be washed normally. Test a hidden seam on delicates (wool, silk, rayon) before full use as the washing soda is strongly alkaline. Not for dry-clean-only garments. Do not use on denim or dark fabrics prone to bleeding.
Keeps six months in a labelled spray bottle in the laundry cupboard. Shake before each use.
